research.job_description_summary: Tech Mahindra hires freshers as Associate Software Engineers. A 2026 GeeksforGeeks write-up describes a first phase of an online aptitude, reasoning and verbal test, an essay and a two-question coding test, followed (after an interview call) by an offline technical interview and an HR interview. A 2025 Glassdoor review describes aptitude, communication, technical discussion and HR rounds. The official careers site was located but not fetched for process details.
required_skills: Quantitative aptitude, reasoning and verbal ability
limitations: The official Tech Mahindra careers site was not fetched, so no round is marked DOCUMENTED; rounds are REPORTED from a 2026 GeeksforGeeks write-up and a 2025 Glassdoor review, which differ slightly (the review lists a communication round instead of an essay).
The GeeksforGeeks write-up (2026-01-16) names no candidate, role or exact questions, only topics; it is used as topic context (class D).
The only dated candidate-attributed question is 'explain OOP' from one Glassdoor review (2025-10-09), recorded as class B, one report, unverified.

The placementpreparation.io interview-questions page carries no publication date and attributes nothing to individual candidates, despite saying questions were reported; it is used as topic context only.
Only the Associate Software Engineer role is supported by sources; no separate track banks were created.
This bank is therefore almost entirely original practice (48 of 50). Treat it as topic-aligned practice, not as 'what they asked'.
Package figures and the 15-day interview-call gap were not used.

Evidence handling: practice questions cite no sources; where a source only supplied topic context it is named in the question notes. Practice and job-description-inferred questions are UNVERIFIED and capped at LOW confidence on import.

Review status: answers, samples and cited counts come from the researcher and were not independently re-run; spot checks only. Source titles and some dates are blank because the sources did not show them.
